TASHKENTSPIRE2-BARRAGE.title: Barrage
TASHKENTSPIRE2-BARRAGE.description:
This card can fire up to 6 [gold]Ammo[/gold] regardless of its current [gold]Ammo[/gold] count.
For each shot fired beyond its current [gold]Ammo[/gold], add a [gold]Spent Shell Casing[/gold] to your hand.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-CHOICE.title: Choice
TASHKENTSPIRE2-CHOICE.description: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of the displayed options and perform its effect.
